label: Crawl4AI fetch
description: Fetch clean page markdown via a Crawl4AI Docker/HTTP server (/md) — use after search when you need full article body, not snippets

description_i18n.en: Fetch clean page markdown via a Crawl4AI Docker/HTTP server (/md) — use after search when you need full article body, not snippets
description_i18n.zh_CN: 通过 Crawl4AI Docker/HTTP 服务（/md）抓取干净页面 Markdown；在搜索之后、需要全文而非摘要时使用
description_i18n.zh_HK: 透過 Crawl4AI Docker/HTTP 服務（/md）擷取乾淨頁面 Markdown；在搜尋之後、需要全文而非摘要時使用

propose_guide: BEST WHEN: NL already has a concrete URL (or upstream searxng/search / tavily/web-search returned URLs) and needs the full readable body for summarize/RAG. Prefer over browserless/browse for ordinary articles, docs, and blogs (lighter). Set filter=fit (default) for readable markdown; bm25+focus_query when only a section matters. FALLBACK to browserless/browse when the page is SPA / bot-walled / empty after crawl. Do NOT use to invent URLs without a prior search step. Do NOT crawl internal/admin hosts — Owner should set blocked_url_hosts.

propose_guide_i18n.en: BEST WHEN: NL already has a concrete URL (or upstream searxng/search / tavily/web-search returned URLs) and needs the full readable body for summarize/RAG. Prefer over browserless/browse for ordinary articles, docs, and blogs (lighter). Set filter=fit (default) for readable markdown; bm25+focus_query when only a section matters. FALLBACK to browserless/browse when the page is SPA / bot-walled / empty after crawl. Do NOT use to invent URLs without a prior search step. Do NOT crawl internal/admin hosts — Owner should set blocked_url_hosts.
propose_guide_i18n.zh_CN: 最佳场景：已有明确 URL（或上游 searxng/search / tavily/web-search 返回链接），需要全文做摘要/RAG。普通文章、文档、博客优先本工具，比 browserless/browse 更轻。默认 filter=fit；只要局部相关内容时用 bm25+focus_query。若 SPA/反爬/正文为空再改 browserless/browse。不要凭空编造 URL。勿抓内网/管理域——Owner 应配置 blocked_url_hosts。
propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 最佳場景：已有明確 URL（或上游 searxng/search / tavily/web-search 返回連結），需要全文做摘要/RAG。普通文章、文件、網誌優先本工具，比 browserless/browse 更輕。預設 filter=fit；只要局部相關內容時用 bm25+focus_query。若 SPA/反爬/正文為空再改 browserless/browse。不要憑空編造 URL。勿抓內網/管理域——Owner 應配置 blocked_url_hosts。

params.name: url
params.description: http(s) page URL to fetch as markdown
params.propose_hint: Pass a URL from searxng/search or tavily/web-search results, not a bare keyword.

params.name: focus_query
params.description: Relevance query when filter is bm25 or llm

blocked_url_hosts.label: Blocked URL hosts
blocked_url_hosts.description: Reject when the target URL host matches (SSRF / internal host guard).

max_content_length.label: Max markdown characters
max_content_length.description: Owner hint for truncating fetched content.
